title: Change metadata quality
description: How reliable the change stamps of a solution are: integrity checks of the import, signals such as mass events, technical authors, missing accounts and counter 0, persons with several names — per file and with the affected objects.
author: fm-lab core

params.name: issue
params.description: Check whose objects are listed: missing, unreadable, duplicate, future, unassigned, mass, technical, no_account, zero_counter or spelling.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of the object list (1-based, 100 rows per page).
